fields.place: Navadvīpa (Māyāpura): the house of Jagannātha Miśra and Śacī-mātā
fields.notes: Household servant of Jagannātha Miśra; after him ran Śacī-mātā's household, washed Nityānanda's feet (CBh Madhya 1.59), served the child Nimāi; after the sannyāsa looked after Śacī-mātā and Viṣṇupriyā, and was looked after by Vaṁśīvadana. In old age took Śrīnivāsa, Narottama and Rāmacandra round the nine islands, and left the world soon after (Bhakti-ratnākara 12-13).

King of Orissa, son of Kapilendra Deva and Pārvatī-devī, father of Mahārāja Pratāparudra (#278). Got the throne by Jagannātha's order; conquered Kāñcī with the help of Jagannātha and Balarāma (the milkmaid Māṇikā's ring) and married Padmāvatī; brought Bhaṇḍa Gaṇeśa from Kāñcī and Sākṣī-gopāla to Cuttack. A Sanskrit scholar and poet.
